_source: UEV-A1 (docs/eras/uev.md, 'A1. Isotopes', line 2 and the Cm/Cf/Bk cuts for A2): three rows of UHV's high flux reactor and transuranium facility. Real processes: plutonium-242 targets irradiated in HFIR breed plutonium-244 by two neutron captures; ORNL's REDC dissolves the targets in nitric acid and cuts the transcurium liquor by HDEHP extraction into curium-californium and berkelium-californium fractions.
_how_it_is_used: Read by server_scripts/grindless/uhv/transcurium.js after tables/transcurium.json; the same format; its types are merged into the main table's, whose data keys stand. Circuits continue the main table's: high_flux_irradiation 4, transuranium_processing 7 and 8.
The spent drivers of plutonium_target go back to UV's pyroprocessing cell with the others; the irradiated target goes to the facility's plutonium_dissolve (-> ZPM's partitioning, plutonium_recovery).
The curium-californium and berkelium-californium nitrates go to ZPM's partitioning cuts (curium_cut, berkelium_cut), whose curium and californium feed UEV's superheavy facility (A2).
